## PREMIUM CHALLENGE CTA (for retargeting, story content, or DM replies to warm engagement)

This isn't a cold top-of-funnel hook, it works best on someone already warm: retargeting an engaged visitor, replying to a comment, or following up in DMs. It leans on identity and urgency instead of pain.

> Most practices get there in 90 days.

>

>
> Let's jump on a call today. I'll show you exactly how.
